methods.name: createPool
methods.desc:
Deploy the pool contract, compiled teal of the contract
must be loaded in dexPoolContractApprovalProgram

methods.name: initPool
methods.desc: Initialize the pool with the given assets & weights

methods.name: preparePool
methods.desc:
Hand a freshly created vault pool over to its admin (the caller) so it can be
bootstrapped in batches via the pool's own addAssets / finalizeBootstrap.

args.name: poolID
args.desc: the vault pool app to hand over.

args.name: coverMBR
args.desc: payment covering the pool's base minimum balance.
